old: Para attack puts the positive charge on the two carbons ortho to the new sp3 carbon and on the carbon bearing OCH3 . From that form, an oxygen lone pair forms a C=O+ π bond, giving the oxonium form, in which every atom has a complete octet. A form with all octets outweighs any form with an electron-deficient carbon, even the tertiary-like cation on the OCH3 carbon. This extra contributor is why OCH3 activates the ring and directs ortho/para.
